assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate a square wildlife photograph to be used as the left photo panel of an image classification website banner. A single red panda standing on a moss-covered fallen log in a sunlit mountain forest, whole animal visible including bushy striped tail, facing camera in three-quarter view. Rich warm reddish-orange fur, detailed whiskers and eyes, soft natural golden morning light, softly blurred cool green forest and distant mountains, premium editorial wildlife photography, realistic anatomy. Subject comfortably inside frame with generous safe margins for square crop. Similar polished natural photographic feeling to a red fox in an alpine meadow. Image only: no text, no charts, no labels, no bounding boxes, no border, no watermark.
